About:

Connor breaks down exactly how he and his student AJ used social media to build an audience from scratch and launch winning Amazon FBA products using short form content, influencers, and pre-launch groups. Connor and AJ share real-world case studies, including AJ’s cocktail cards success story, to show step-by-step how to use TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts to drive massive demand before an Amazon launch.

• How Connor uses social media marketing to build an audience with no followers for Amazon FBA and ecommerce product launches
• Why social media is critical for Amazon FBA product launches and long-term ecommerce success
• AJ’s case study: how AJ used TikTok to go from zero followers to hundreds of thousands with cocktail cards content
• How AJ leveraged short form content and TikTok growth to generate millions of views and raise $100,000 on Indiegogo before selling on Amazon
• Using TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts for organic reach, audience building, and Amazon product demand
• Why short form content is prioritized by social platforms and how algorithms reward engaging videos
• How Connor and AJ create strong hooks for short form content to grab attention in the first seconds
• Maintaining engagement and retention in short form videos to boost watch time and algorithm reach
• Funnel hacking and copying proven viral content formats for Amazon FBA and ecommerce products
• Creating looping videos to increase watch time, retention, and social media growth
• The importance of daily posting and consistency on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
• Why every piece of content needs an offer or call to action to drive traffic and Amazon sales
• Building email lists and pre-launch audiences before an Amazon FBA launch or Kickstarter/Indiegogo campaign
• Influencer marketing strategies for ecommerce and Amazon sellers, taught by Connor and demonstrated with AJ’s launch
• Why micro influencers are more effective and affordable than macro influencers for product promotion
• How Connor and AJ approach working with micro influencers, including product-for-post and affiliate-style influencer partnerships
• Using influencers to create content and promote your product when you don’t want to be on camera
• Building and managing a product launch group to warm up leads before an Amazon FBA launch
• Using behind-the-scenes content to build loyalty, reciprocity, and excitement for a new Amazon product
• Getting product feedback before manufacturing and launch to improve offers and conversions
• How pre-launch groups and social media audiences drive stronger Amazon launches and Kickstarter/Indiegogo results

This video is packed with Amazon FBA, ecommerce, product launch strategy, social media marketing, short form content, TikTok growth, Instagram Reels strategy, YouTube Shorts, influencer marketing, micro influencer outreach, pre-launch audience building, product launch groups, and real-world Amazon success examples from Connor and AJ’s cocktail cards case study.
